manifest.name: dsh-meow-cat
manifest.description: A cat runs across the bottom of the DeepSeek Harness web UI with a synthesized meow every time a conversation turn ends.
manifest.author: OneeMe

bundle.text:
# dsh-meow-cat bundle patch.
#
# Applied as one layer over the dsh-base / dsh-web-app layers when this package
# is listed in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` (which `dsh plugin add`
# reconciles automatically from the `dsh.bundle.patch` declaration).
#
# A single dual-face row: the node half (lib/index.js) counts finished
# conversation turns and serves a status endpoint, and the browser half
# (lib/client.js) — discovered from the package's `dsh.client` metadata —
# polls that endpoint and runs the cat. Both halves come from the one package
# name below.
- insert:
    - id: meow-cat
      name: dsh-meow-cat

declared.name: dsh-meow-cat.config
declared.description: JSON override stored in browser localStorage

readme.text: Every time a conversation turn ends in the DeepSeek Harness web UI, a small cat 🐈 runs across the bottom of the window with a "喵~" speech bubble and a meow. The meow is synthesized at runtime — no audio assets, no external URLs, no dependencies — and the whole plugin is two plain JavaScript files plus a one-row bundle patch.

```bash
npx dshpub add dsh-pub/dsh-meow-cat --profile web
```

The command pins the current public commit, validates the bundle contract, and forwards to the native `dsh plugin --profile web add …`. Restart your `dsh web` process afterwards; the cat loads with the next page load and runs for the first time when the in-flight turn ends.

- **Node half** (`lib/index.js`): counts finished turns on the host-plane `agent/status` event (`idle` = no driver remains scheduled) and serves the count at `GET /plugins/dsh-meow-cat/status`.
- **Browser half** (`lib/client.js`): polls the endpoint, and on every increment runs a pure-CSS cat animation across a click-through fixed layer and plays the synthesized meow.
- **Meow synthesis**: a 16-bit mono WAV is generated in memory — a 520→760→430 Hz pitch contour ("mi-aa-ou") with mid-note vibrato and a nasal harmonic stack — and played as a base64 data URI.

Defaults work out of the box. To tune it live, set a JSON override in your browser console (re-read on every poll):

```js
localStorage.setItem("dsh-meow-cat.config", JSON.stringify({
  enabled: true,   // master switch
  pollMs: 1500,    // status poll interval, min 250
  volume: 1.0,     // meow volume 0~1

- Browsers block audio until the page has seen a user gesture; the very first meow after a fresh page load may be silent (sending any message unlocks it).
- The turn counter is per `dsh web` process and host-plane: the cat runs when **any** session in the process finishes a turn, and the count resets on server restart.
- The registry badge reports `not listed` until the listing commit deploys.
每当 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面里的一轮对话结束，一只小猫 🐈 就会跑过窗口底部，带着"喵~"气泡和一声猫叫。喵声是运行时实时合成的——没有音频资源、没有外部 URL、零依赖——整个插件就是两个纯 JavaScript 文件加一行 bundle patch。

```bash
npx dshpub add dsh-pub/dsh-meow-cat --profile web
```

该命令会固定当前公开 commit、校验 bundle 契约，并转发给原生的 `dsh plugin --profile web add …`。安装后重启 `dsh web` 进程；下次打开页面时小猫加载，当前这轮对话结束时它第一次跑出来。

- **Node 半端**(`lib/index.js`):在 host 面监听 `agent/status` 事件(`idle` 即一轮对话结束),把完成轮数通过 `GET /plugins/dsh-meow-cat/status` 提供给浏览器。
- **浏览器半端**(`lib/client.js`):轮询该端点,计数每增加一次,就在点击穿透的固定图层上跑一段纯 CSS 小猫动画,并播放合成的喵声。
- **喵声合成**:在内存里生成 16-bit 单声道 WAV——520→760→430 Hz 的"mi-aa-ou"音高轮廓,带中段颤音和鼻音泛音列——以 base64 data URI 播放。

开箱即用。如需实时调整,在浏览器控制台写入 JSON 覆盖项(每次轮询都会重读):

```js
localStorage.setItem("dsh-meow-cat.config", JSON.stringify({
  enabled: true,   // 总开关
  pollMs: 1500,    // 轮询间隔,最小 250
  volume: 1.0,     // 音量 0~1

- 浏览器在页面发生用户手势前会拦截有声播放:刚刷新页面后的第一声喵可能是静音(随便发一条消息即可解锁)。
- 计数器是 `dsh web` 进程级、host 面的:进程里**任意**会话结束一轮对话都会触发小猫,服务重启后计数归零。
- 收录徽章在收录 commit 部署前会显示 `not listed`。
